title: MARK LEGENDS AND OLD SAVE CHECKS
why: The old mouse check pressed the same persistent spot twice, so the second press correctly cleared it. The controller legend already says mark; the keyboard compact row still said ping. Watch: middle mouse sets one mark, pressing that spot again clears it, and D-UP marks on a pad.
now: The compact party legends both say mark. Old saved keys remain unchanged. Regression checks stage independent mouse presses and cover all three views and both roles.

edits.anchor: if(typeof NET==='object'&&NET&&NET.on){ if(padOn()) MN.push(['Y','drop to trade']); else MN.push(['V','drop to trade'],['N','ping']); }   /* v35.xx (cw-meleez): drop is on V */   // v18.27: his order, trading is dropping
edits.replacement: if(typeof NET==='object'&&NET&&NET.on){ if(padOn()) MN.push(['Y','drop to trade']); else MN.push(['V','drop to trade'],['N','mark']); }   /* v35.xx (cw-meleez): drop is on V */   // v18.27: his order, trading is dropping   // v28.xx (cw-cx-marklegacy): his single mark order also names the keyboard party row.
